items.item_text: Current California RN license
Background Check and Live Scan
Employment Misconduct
Legal Right to Work in the United States
Vaccination Policies
Smoking and Tobacco Policy
Drug Free Environment
California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act
E-Verify
Pre-Placement Health Evaluation
Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Public Health, Pharmacy, Business, Administration or related field
Master's Degree
Previous experience or exposure to quality, patient safety, infection control, or performance improvement methodologies (includes educational experience if applicable)
Previous experience creating, maintaining, and extracting information from a variety of databases
Minimum 2 years clinical RN experience

Incumbent is responsible for providing a range of administrative and analytical functions critical to the implementation of the quality assurance and performance improvement programs through effective identification of sources and collection of data, including medical chart review and query of various databases / information systems. May serve as a resource for quality through the implementation of processes and standards across the continuum to ensure compliance and improvement in quality of care and patient safety.
Resourcefulness to identify and search for information that is not readily available
Must demonstrate meticulous attention to accuracy with data collection and reporting
Working knowledge of statistics
Strong knowledge of MS Office Suite applications with emphasis on Excel and Viseo
Strong analytical skills to effectively comprehend complex system reports and analyze an array into an actionable form
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Knowledge of quality improvement methodologies
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Excellent interpersonal communication skills to communicate effectively with physicians, managers and high-level administrative staff as well as support staff who are critical to departmental functions
Ability to prioritize and contribute to simultaneous projects and facilitate teamwork among project staff / participants
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality in operational transactions and communications
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
